claims.statement: The Waydroid hardware composer service (vendor.hwcomposer-2-1, pid 363) crashed with a SIGSEGV null pointer dereference in hwcomposer.waydroid.so at wl_proxy_marshal+242, reached via hwc_set during a presentDisplay call.

The HWC crash is the earliest failure in the cycle, occurring at 19:47:42.023, before the surfaceflinger abort (19:47:42.172) and before the read-only filesystem errors and service restarts (19:47:46+).
SurfaceFlinger (pid 105) aborted with 'DEAD_OBJECT' from a failed HIDL call to the composer, a downstream consequence of the HWC process death.
The system_server (pid 247) threw a fatal Surface$OutOfResourcesException: DEAD_OBJECT in nativeCreate, consistent with the graphics stack (composer/surfaceflinger) being unavailable.

The container enters a restart loop: init repeatedly fails createProcessGroup with 'Read-only file system' on /sys/fs/cgroup/uid_*, and servicemanager/hwservicemanager repeatedly report 'Could not find ... for ctl.interface_start' for SurfaceFlinger and the composer.

The read-only /sys/fs/cgroup filesystem is a container-boundary configuration defect that prevents process-group creation for every service, but it is a persistent environmental condition rather than the trigger of the graphics crash; the two coexist in the same cycle.
The primary failure candidate is the Waydroid HWC (hwcomposer.waydroid.so) null-pointer crash, which cascades into surfaceflinger and system_server failures and prevents startup completion.

missing_evidence: Full native crash dump with register/memory disassembly
hwcomposer.waydroid.so source or symbols for wl_proxy_marshal

missing_evidence: Binder transaction logs between surfaceflinger and composer before the abort

Capture a full tombstones/native crash dump for hwcomposer.waydroid.so to identify the null pointer in wl_proxy_marshal.

Check whether the HWC crash reproduces after making cgroup writable, to isolate the two failure modes.
Review Waydroid/LineageOS image version compatibility between hwcomposer.waydroid.so and the host Wayland compositor.
